sections.title: Work needing attention
sections.sql: SELECT project,task,owner,due_on,reason FROM v_attention ORDER BY days_overdue DESC,task

sections.title: Owner workload
sections.sql: SELECT owner,weekly_hours,due_week_hours,over_capacity_hours,undated_tasks FROM v_owner_load ORDER BY owner

sections.title: Delivery status
sections.sql: SELECT project,owner,status,tasks,open,overdue,blocked FROM v_project_health ORDER BY project

sections.title: Checks needing a person
sections.sql: SELECT record,finding,rule,source FROM v_compliance ORDER BY rule,record
